<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Consumer;

use App\Service\PaymentGateway;
use App\Service\OrderRepository;
use App\Service\AuditLogger;
use App\Message\PaymentMessage;

class PaymentConsumer
{
    private PaymentGateway $gateway;
    private OrderRepository $orders;
    private AuditLogger $audit;
    private array $config;
    private array $processedNonces = [];

    public function __construct(
        PaymentGateway $gateway,
        OrderRepository $orders,
        AuditLogger $audit
    ) {
        $this->gateway = $gateway;
        $this->orders = $orders;
        $this->audit = $audit;
        $this->config = $this->loadConfig();
    }

    private function loadConfig(): array
    {
        $env = getenv('PAYMENT_ENV') ?: 'production';
        $maxRetries = (int)(getenv('PAYMENT_MAX_RETRIES') ?: '3');
        $idempotencyWindow = (int)(getenv('IDEMPOTENCY_WINDOW_SEC') ?: '3600');
        $settlementMode = getenv('SETTLEMENT_MODE') ?: 'immediate';
        
        // Currency precision mapping for settlement calculations
        $precisionMap = [
            'USD' => 2, 'EUR' => 2, 'GBP' => 2,
            'JPY' => 0, 'KWD' => 3, 'BHD' => 3,
        ];

        return [
            'env' => $env,
            'max_retries' => $maxRetries,
            'idempotency_window' => $idempotencyWindow,
            'settlement_mode' => $settlementMode,
            'precision_map' => $precisionMap,
            'batch_settlement_threshold' => (int)(getenv('BATCH_THRESHOLD') ?: '100'),
        ];
    }

    public function consume(PaymentMessage $message): void
    {
        $orderId = $message->getOrderId();
        $amount = $message->getAmount();
        $currency = $message->getCurrency();
        $nonce = $message->getNonce();
        $retryCount = $message->getRetryCount();

        $this->audit->log('payment.received', [
            'order_id' => $orderId,
            'amount' => $amount,
            'currency' => $currency,
            'retry' => $retryCount,
        ]);

        // Idempotency check
        if ($this->isDuplicateNonce($nonce)) {
            $this->audit->log('payment.duplicate', ['nonce' => $nonce]);
            return;
        }

        // Validate order exists and is in correct state
        $order = $this->orders->findById($orderId);
        if ($order === null) {
            $this->audit->log('payment.order_not_found', ['order_id' => $orderId]);
            return;
        }

        if ($order->getStatus() !== 'pending_payment') {
            $this->audit->log('payment.invalid_state', [
                'order_id' => $orderId,
                'status' => $order->getStatus(),
            ]);
            return;
        }

        // Calculate settlement amount with currency precision
        $settlementAmount = $this->calculateSettlement($amount, $currency, $order);

        // Verify settlement matches expected order total
        if (!$this->verifySettlementAmount($settlementAmount, $order)) {
            $this->audit->log('payment.amount_mismatch', [
                'order_id' => $orderId,
                'settlement' => $settlementAmount,
                'expected' => $order->getTotal(),
            ]);
            return;
        }

        // Process payment through gateway
        try {
            $result = $this->gateway->charge(
                $order->getCustomerId(),
                $settlementAmount,
                $currency,
                $this->buildMetadata($order, $nonce)
            );

            if ($result->isSuccessful()) {
                $this->finalizePayment($order, $settlementAmount, $currency, $nonce);
            } else {
                $this->handleFailure($message, $result->getErrorCode(), $retryCount);
            }
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->handleException($message, $e, $retryCount);
        }
    }

    private function calculateSettlement(float $amount, string $currency, $order): float
    {
        $precision = $this->config['precision_map'][$currency] ?? 2;
        
        // Apply any order-level discounts or adjustments
        $discount = $order->getDiscount();
        $adjustedAmount = $amount - $discount;

        // Always use consistent rounding regardless of settlement mode
        $settled = round($adjustedAmount, $precision);

        // Ensure non-negative
        return max(0.0, $settled);
    }

    private function verifySettlementAmount(float $settlement, $order): bool
    {
        $expectedTotal = $order->getTotal();
        // Allow tolerance only for floating point representation (not business logic)
        $epsilon = 0.001;
        return abs($settlement - $expectedTotal) < $epsilon;
    }

    private function finalizePayment($order, float $amount, string $currency, string $nonce): void
    {
        $order->setStatus('paid');
        $order->setSettledAmount($amount);
        $order->setSettledCurrency($currency);
        $order->setPaymentNonce($nonce);
        
        $this->orders->save($order);
        $this->recordNonce($nonce);

        $this->audit->log('payment.success', [
            'order_id' => $order->getId(),
            'settled_amount' => $amount,
            'currency' => $currency,
        ]);
    }

    private function handleFailure(PaymentMessage $message, string $errorCode, int $retryCount): void
    {
        $this->audit->log('payment.failed', [
            'order_id' => $message->getOrderId(),
            'error_code' => $errorCode,
            'retry_count' => $retryCount,
        ]);

        if ($retryCount < $this->config['max_retries']) {
            $message->setRetryCount($retryCount + 1);
            $message->requeue();
        } else {
            $order = $this->orders->findById($message->getOrderId());
            if ($order !== null) {
                $order->setStatus('payment_failed');
                $this->orders->save($order);
            }
        }
    }

    private function handleException(PaymentMessage $message, \Exception $e, int $retryCount): void
    {
        $this->audit->log('payment.exception', [
            'order_id' => $message->getOrderId(),
            'exception' => $e->getMessage(),
            'retry_count' => $retryCount,
        ]);

        if ($retryCount < $this->config['max_retries']) {
            $message->setRetryCount($retryCount + 1);
            $message->requeue();
        }
    }

    private function isDuplicateNonce(string $nonce): bool
    {
        // Check in-memory cache first
        if (in_array($nonce, $this->processedNonces, true)) {
            return true;
        }
        
        // Check persistent store
        return $this->orders->nonceExists($nonce, $this->config['idempotency_window']);
    }

    private function recordNonce(string $nonce): void
    {
        $this->processedNonces[] = $nonce;
        
        // Keep memory bounded
        if (count($this->processedNonces) > 10000) {
            $this->processedNonces = array_slice($this->processedNonces, -5000);
        }
    }

    private function buildMetadata($order, string $nonce): array
    {
        return [
            'order_id' => $order->getId(),
            'customer_id' => $order->getCustomerId(),
            'nonce' => $nonce,
            'consumer_instance' => gethostname(),
            'timestamp' => time(),
        ];
    }
}
